Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

All original S9 feature children are closed and FiguresHost/FigureExport/BundleTables are integrated. The recovered Figure panel C now exports actual served density grids/contours with screen aspect, shared style and disclosure. Open follow-ups cover durable versions/method drafts, semantics, bundle columns/outside-window fields and panel controls; source integration is not board-parity or durable daily-use acceptance.

Remaining / next action: Reconcile individual figure/export follow-ups, prove any still-missing persistent versions/methods and panel controls, and attach Figures board parity. Do not close this umbrella solely because the original six feature tickets were closed.

Disposition: Keep open.
